title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
description:
About Mitre Media Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time. Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect! About the Role As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions. You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality. Responsibilities Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8) Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences. Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions. Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing. Required Technical Skills Back-End Ruby (5+ years, expert-level) Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred) PostgreSQL (or MySQL) Elasticsearch Redis Docker Front-End StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6 Tailwind CSS HTML HTTP AI Integration Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic) Nice-to-Have Technical Skills Kubernetes for microservices orchestration React for advanced front-end components Graph databases for complex financial data Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects Required Soft Skills Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code Team player comfortable as an individual contributor Why Join Us? Impactful Work : Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights. Cutting-Edge Tech : Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture. Autonomy and Influence : Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate. Competitive Compensation : $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits. Remote Flexibility : Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC Growth Opportunities : Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation. Dynamic Culture : Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech. About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data. How to Apply Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.
Salary: $170k - $200k

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer
Salary: $1000 per task

description: Lumen Labs | Robotics/Hardware Engineer, Simulation Engineer | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE | Full-time | $150k–200k + equity | https://lumenresearch.co Howdy! Lumen Labs is building the cognitive layer for physical AI. Nearly every major robotics effort today teaches machines by showing them thousands of hours of human teleoperation. We think that paradigm has a ceiling, and we’re working on nature-inspired architectures for unstructured environments (construction sites, mining, pipelines, battlefield). Pre-seed, backed by top VC funds and operators from robotics/AI companies. Today we run wheeled navigation, we’re dipping our toes into drones, and we’re eyeing weirder platforms like home inspection. We’re a small team hiring two engineers who will work closely with each other and with our model engineer: ROBOTICS / HARDWARE ENGINEER: Own the hardware and infrastructure that keeps our research platforms running: the ROS2 (Humble) stack across onboard and offboard compute, sensor integration and calibration (LiDAR, depth, IMU, encoders), the safety pipeline during autonomous runs, and getting trained policies onto real hardware. Will be hands-on with real mobile robots (UART, encoders, PWM, IMU, LiDAR), strong Python + embedded, comfortable reading code you didn’t write, and can debug hardware and firmware at the same time. Full posting: https://desert-bearskin-26d.notion.site/Robotics-Engineer-Ro... Mostly MuJoCo and Gazebo today, moving toward Isaac Sim, and some other more bespoke sims. You will be building task simulators for training and testing and keeping them running (GPS-denied drone nav, construction sites, boat cleaning, forklifts, abstract control), including physics, honest sensor models, digital twins of our real platforms, domain randomization, and the sim compute. Dungeon Master. If you have built or substantially rebuilt a simulator of some kind (robotics/RL is closest, but a physics-based game, scientific sim, or flight sim mod counts) this would be a good role for you. Comfortable with the Gymnasium/dm_control way of thinking, can pick up GPU-vectorized sim (MJX, Isaac Lab, JAX) quickly, and test-driven. Full posting: https://desert-bearskin-26d.notion.site/Simulation-Engineer-... Email hi@lumenresearch.co, mention HN and which role, and tell us about a project you’ve built. title: Senior Systems / Rust Engineer
description: Blockrotate| Senior Systems / Rust Engineer | Remote (US/EU timezones preferred) | Full-time | $130k - $170k + Equity Blockrotate ( https://blockrotate.com ) builds low-latency copy-trading and execution infrastructure for Polymarket and prediction markets. Copy trading on prediction markets has strange market microstructure. Unlike deep perp DEXes (Binance, Hyperliquid), Polymarket orderbooks are bounded, often thin, and subject to severe adverse selection. When a high-volume leader buys, the book moves immediately. If followers lag by a few hundred milliseconds, or if a platform taxes every order with a 50bps fee, follower alpha drops to zero. Most existing tools in this space either hit users with high per-trade taker fees or ask them to export and paste their master private key into a database. We took a different approach: isolated per-bot deposit wallets (non-custodial via EIP-1967/1271 proxies) and co-located autonomous Rust workers running delta-sync loops directly against the Polymarket CLOB. Stack: - Backend: Rust, Tokio, Axum, Protobuf over WebSockets, SQLite (WAL mode) - Trading Engine: Custom Polymarket CLOB & Data API clients, EIP-712 signing, dynamic slippage ladders, momentum filters, circuit breakers - Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS What you’d actually work on: - Squeezing latency out of the execution hot path (delta position calculation, order placement, nonce handling, fill verification). - Building better execution protection: momentum filters to dodge toxic order flow, fill stabilization windows, and handling thin book liquidity without moving the market against yourself. - Scaling worker orchestration: our C2 server talks Protobuf to distributed bot workers with monotonic sequence IDs and autonomous reconnect failover. As bot volume scales, we need to keep state reconciliation bulletproof. - Investigating and exploiting prediction market quirks (rebate structures, orderbook snapshotting, MEV/relayer bottlenecks). What we look for: - Strong async Rust experience (Tokio, concurrency, practical memory management). - Experience dealing with websockets, exchange orderbooks, or trading infrastructure shoot an email to jobs@blockrotate.com and tell us why you would be a good fit for us.
